verses.gurmukhi: ਗਜ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਪਤੰਗ ਅਲਿ ਇਕਤੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਰੋਗਿ ਪਚੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gaj mirag meen pata(n)g al ikat ikat rog pacha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The Elephant, deer, fish, moth and bumblebee have one disease each, namely,  attraction for lust, sound, enjoyment, beautiful appearance and fragrance respectively, and they are consumed by them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਪੰਜਿ ਰੋਗ ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਕੁਸੂਤੁ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: maanas dhehee pa(n)j rog pa(n)je dhoot kusoot kara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: But the man has all the five ailments and these five always create turbulences in his life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਡਾਇਣੀ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਬਹੁ ਰੋਗ ਵਧੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: aasaa manasaa ddainee harakh sog bahu rog vadha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The witches in the form of hope and desires and the happiness and sorrows further aggravate the diseases.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗਿ ਭੰਭਲਭੂਸੇ ਖਾਇ ਭਵੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: manmukh dhoojai bhai lag bha(n)bhalabhoose khai bhava(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Controlled by duality, the deluded manmukh runs here and there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਸਾਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sachaa paatasaeh gurmukh gaaddee raahu chala(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The true Guru is the true king and the gurmukhs move on the highway pointed out by Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਭਜਿ ਗਏ ਠਗ ਚੋਰ ਡਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat mil chalanaa bhaj ge Thag chor ddara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Moving along with and in the holy congregation,
the theives and cheats in the form of lust for materials run away.
